nodes.name: Every 5 Minutes
nodes.notes: Runs the full TradeIQ local paper-trading cycle every 5 minutes.

nodes.name: Fetch Market Data
nodes.notes: Calls data_fetcher.fetch_and_store() so yfinance data is saved into trading.db.

nodes.name: Run Sentiment
nodes.notes: Fetches Google News RSS through Python, scores headlines, and saves sentiment rows.

nodes.name: Run ML Predictions
nodes.notes: Runs the ensemble prediction pipeline and saves latest BUY/SELL/HOLD signals.

nodes.name: Load Latest Signals
nodes.notes: Reads the latest saved signals from ml_predictions.

nodes.name: Route Signals
nodes.notes: Groups latest signals for reporting and downstream notification.

nodes.name: Execute Paper Trades
nodes.notes: Runs BUY/SELL agents with risk controls in paper mode.

nodes.name: Portfolio Status
nodes.notes: Reads cash, starting balance, open positions, and recent trades.

nodes.name: Build Cycle Report
nodes.notes: Final workflow output. Add Telegram, Email, Discord, or Google Sheets nodes after this node if desired.
